preconditions.description: The number of rows n in the flag matrix is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The number of columns m in the flag matrix is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of segments q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + q + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1])
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly n+1+q lines: first line with n, m, q; next n lines with m integers each; followed by q lines with segment queries.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All elements in the flag matrix are positive integers not exceeding 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(l) <= int(r) <= m for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:] for l, r in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each segment query (l, r) satisfies 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(count_components(matrix, l, r)) for matrix, l, r in zip(parse_matrix(stdin), parse_queries(stdin))) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each segment query (l, r), the output is the number of connected components in the submatrix formed by columns l to r (1-based) of the flag matrix, where a component is a set of adjacent cells (horizontally or vertically) with the same value.
